title: 味患出离

evidence.pali: ‘‘Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā evaṃ viññāṇaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇasamudayaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇanirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ abhiññāya; evaṃ viññāṇassa assādaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇassa ādīnavaṃ abhiññāya, evaṃ viññāṇassa nissaraṇaṃ abhiññāya viññāṇassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipannā, te suppaṭipannā. Ye suppaṭipannā, te imasmiṃ dhammavinaye gādhanti.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “诸比丘，凡是任何沙门或婆罗门，如是了知识，如是了知识的生起，如是了知识的灭尽，如是了知导向识灭尽之道；如是了知识的乐味，如是了知识的过患，如是了知识的出离，为了对识厌离、离贪、灭尽而修行，他们是善修行者。凡是善修行者，就在此法与律中得以确立。
evidence.english: “Bhikkhus, whatever ascetics or brahmins who, having directly known consciousness in this way, having directly known the origin of consciousness, having directly known the cessation of consciousness, having directly known the way leading to the cessation of consciousness; having directly known the gratification of consciousness, having directly known the danger of consciousness, having directly known the escape from consciousness, are practicing for disenchantment, dispassion, and cessation regarding consciousness—they are practicing well. Those who practice well gain a firm footing in this Dhamma and Discipline.”

isolation_reason: 旧图保留的独立概念有直接 V4 逐句证据，但当前闭包没有足够直接的关系句将其连接到另一发布节点；为避免凭概念相似度补边，保留为可检索、可引用的独立节点。
